ordering.rule: contiguous 00..N, foundations first, parents before their children, domains in declared precedence
ordering.limitation: feature-register.json exposes no depends_on/blocked_by field, so prerequisite ordering between features cannot be derived without inventing data. Ordering is by declared domain precedence and feature_id sequence.

screen_command_binding.method: derived by shared domain vocabulary (screen domain + its workflow domains); the specification declares no screen-to-command edge
